# SeoFlow — Full Content for AI Agents

> AI-optimized reference for the complete SeoFlow project — architecture, modules, agents, pipeline steps, and developer guide.

---

## Overview

SeoFlow is a portable, AI-powered SEO pipeline that lives in your repo (not a SaaS dashboard). It automates content audits, keyword research, internal linking, image enrichment, AI content improvements, technical SEO checks, and publishing — all from the command line.

**GitHub:** https://github.com/imsankz/seoflow
**License:** MIT
**Runtime:** Node.js 18+, TypeScript (tsx)

---

## Installation

### One-liner (recommended)
```bash
bash <(curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imsankz/seoflow/main/install.sh)
```
Creates `seoflow.config.json`, adds npm scripts, configures `.gitignore`.

### Manual
```bash
git clone https://github.com/imsankz/seoflow.git .seoflow
cd .seoflow
npm install
npm run seoflow:init
```

---

## Configuration

SeoFlow uses `seoflow.config.json` in the target repo. Generate with `seoflow init`.

### Required Fields
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `siteName` | Your site name (e.g., "My Travel Blog") |
| `siteUrl` | Your site URL (e.g., "https://example.com") |
| `author` | Author name |
| `authorLocation` | Author location |
| `postsDir` | Directory containing blog posts |

### Optional Fields
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `writingSample` | Single voice sample for AI generation |
| `writingSamples` | Per-content-type voice samples (guide, review, etc.) |
| `contentFormat` | "mdx", "markdown", or "wordpress" |
| `imageSearchFallback` | Default image search term |
| `contentDomain` | e.g., "travel blog", "SaaS product" |
| `aiLimits` | Cost guardrails for bulk runs |

### API Keys (`.env.local`)
SeoFlow reads from `.env.local` for optional integrations (GSC, SEMrush, NeuronWriter, Pexels, etc.).

---

## CLI Commands

### Pipeline Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `seoflow init` | Interactive setup — generates config |
| `seoflow status` | Pipeline state, GSC coverage, learning summary |
| `seoflow audit` | Run pipeline on top 10 priority posts |
| `seoflow audit <slug>` | Run pipeline on one post |
| `seoflow audit https://<url>` | Live URL SEO audit |
| `seoflow orchestrate <slug>` | Orchestrator pipeline with dependency resolution |
| `seoflow run <slug>` | Alias for orchestrate |

### Learning & Brain
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `seoflow learn` | Learning insights (step effectiveness, patterns) |
| `seoflow learning export [file]` | Export learning bundle |
| `seoflow learning import <file>` | Import learning bundle |
| `seoflow brain` | Brain summary + vault stats |
| `seoflow vault` | Vault summary directly |

### Content Generation
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `seoflow generate` | Generate new posts from keywords |
| `seoflow publish` | Dry-run unpublished posts |
| `seoflow publish --go` | Publish top candidates |
| `seoflow cluster <seed>` | Semantic topic cluster plan |
| `seoflow brief <keyword>` | SEO content brief |

### Extensions
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `seoflow extensions` | List optional extensions |
| `seoflow extensions install <id>` | Install an extension |
| `seoflow extensions status` | Show installed state |

### Global Flags
| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--dry-run` | Preview without writing |
| `--limit <n>` | Max posts to process (default: 10) |
| `--slug <slug>` | Target one specific post |
| `--reset-slug` | Re-audit a completed post |
| `--mode <step>` | Run only one step: meta\|links\|images\|keywords\|etc. |

---

## Pipeline Steps (Detailed)

### 1. Keywords
- Source: SEMrush API (if key configured) or Ubersuggest MCP (OAuth)
- Output: focusKeyword + related terms + SERP analysis
- Cached in `keywordCachePath`

### 2. Meta
- Validates: schema markup, description length, focusKeyword usage
- Fixes: missing lastModified, keyword-optimized titles
- Output: structured metadata sidecar

### 3. Links
- Scans post content for trigger keywords
- Injects contextual internal links from configured trigger map
- Respects `linkDensity` limits per post

### 4. Images
- Fetches Pexels/Unsplash images per H2 section
- Default: 1 image per section, max 2 per post
- Adds alt text, captions, lazy loading

### 5. Neuron (NLP)
- NeuronWriter API: target word count, missing terms, People Also Ask
- Compares against top 10 SERP competitors

### 6. Content (AI)
- LLM (Gemini/OpenRouter): FAQ generation, thin section expansion
- Weaves NLP missing terms naturally into existing content
- Uses `writingSample` for voice consistency

### 7. Review
- SEO score 1-10 with breakdown
- Quick wins list with auto-fix for title/meta
- Human-readable summary

### 8. Schema
- Validates existing Schema.org structured data
- Generates missing schema (Article, FAQ, HowTo, Product, etc.)
- JSON-LD format

### 9. Quality
- E-E-A-T signal detection (author bylines, cited sources, dates)
- Readability score (Flesch-Kincaid)
- Content depth analysis

### 10. Technical
- Broken link detection (internal + external)
- Redirect chain analysis
- Performance hints (image optimization, Core Web Vitals)

### 11. FactCheck
- Price/claim verification via Google Search grounding API
- Flags unsupported claims for human review

### 12. Report
- Exports full audit as PDF
- Includes: scores, findings, fix recommendations

---

## Architecture

### Module Structure

```
.seoflow/
├── run.ts                        # Pipeline CLI entry point
├── bin/                          # CLI entry (dist)
├── agents/                       # 18 SEO specialist agents
│   ├── seo-backlinks.md
│   ├── seo-cluster.md
│   ├── seo-content.md
│   ├── seo-dataforseo.md
│   ├── seo-drift.md
│   ├── seo-ecommerce.md
│   ├── seo-flow.md
│   ├── seo-geo.md
│   ├── seo-google.md
│   ├── seo-image-gen.md
│   ├── seo-local.md
│   ├── seo-maps.md
│   ├── seo-performance.md
│   ├── seo-schema.md
│   ├── seo-sitemap.md
│   ├── seo-sxo.md
│   ├── seo-technical.md
│   └── seo-visual.md
├── lib/                          # Core library
│   ├── config.ts                 # Site config loader
│   ├── types.ts                  # Shared interfaces
│   ├── env-loader.ts             # .env.local parser
│   ├── mdx-parser.ts             # MDX/Markdown parsing
│   ├── gsc-client.ts             # GSC API client
│   ├── gsc-parser.ts             # GSC CSV + live API
│   ├── gemini-client.ts          # Gemini API client
│   ├── openrouter-client.ts      # OpenRouter client
│   ├── ai-provider.ts            # Unified AI (6 providers with auto-fallback)
│   ├── pexels-client.ts          # Image search
│   ├── neuronwriter.ts           # NeuronWriter API
│   ├── ubersuggest-client.ts     # Keyword research (cached MCP)
│   ├── ahrefs-client.ts          # Ahrefs backlink API
│   ├── semrush-client.ts         # SEMrush API client
│   ├── learning.ts               # Self-learning system
│   ├── audit-log.ts              # Audit logging
│   ├── schema.ts                 # Schema.org generation + validation
│   ├── cluster.ts                # Semantic topic clustering
│   ├── content-brief.ts          # SEO content brief generator
│   ├── generator.ts              # Content generation
│   ├── publisher.ts              # Publishing workflow
│   ├── url-auditor.ts            # Live URL SEO audit (23K lines)
│   ├── validator.ts              # Config/env validator
│   ├── degradation.ts            # Graceful integration degradation
│   ├── structured-output.ts      # Typed JSON sidecars
│   ├── extensions.ts             # Extension management
│   ├── installer.ts              # Install/uninstall logic
│   ├── init.ts                   # Interactive init
│   ├── backlinks/                # Backlink analysis
│   ├── brain/                    # Brain vault system
│   ├── content-quality/          # E-E-A-T + humanizer
│   ├── drift/                    # SEO drift monitoring
│   ├── orchestrator/             # Dependency-aware step runner
│   ├── providers/                # 6 LLM providers with fallback
│   ├── python/                   # Python script wrappers
│   ├── reports/                  # PDF report generation
│   └── technical/                # PageSpeed + CrUX
├── pipeline/                     # Pipeline orchestration
│   ├── steps.ts                  # All pipeline steps
│   ├── technical.ts              # Technical audit step
│   ├── content-quality.ts        # Content quality step
│   └── report-export.ts          # Report export step
├── skills/                       # Claude Code skill definitions
├── extensions/                   # Optional integrations
│   ├── ahrefs/                   # Backlink analysis
│   ├── banana/                   # Image generation
│   ├── bing-webmaster/           # Bing search data
│   ├── dataforseo/               # Keyword + SERP data
│   ├── firecrawl/                # Crawling + scraping
│   ├── profound/                 # Content analysis
│   ├── seranking/                # Rank tracking
│   └── unlighthouse/             # Lighthouse audits
├── hooks/                        # PostToolUse validation hooks
├── docs/                         # Documentation
│   ├── getting-started.md
│   └── INTEGRATION_PLAN.md
├── data/                         # Generated data (gitignored)
│   └── google-updates.json
├── install.sh                    # Unix installer
├── install.ps1                   # Windows installer
├── uninstall.sh                  # Unix uninstaller
├── uninstall.ps1                 # Windows uninstaller
└── build.mjs                     # Build script
```

### AI Provider System

SeoFlow has a unified AI provider with 6 providers and auto-fallback:
1. **Gemini** (Google AI Studio) — primary, used for most pipeline AI operations
2. **OpenRouter** — fallback, with configurable models
3. Additional providers in `lib/providers/`

Each call has configurable budget limits (`aiLimits`) to control costs in bulk runs.

### Brain Vault System

Persistent context store across pipeline runs:
- `hot.md` — Current session state, overwritten each run
- `log.md` — Append-only log of all pipeline actions
- `vault notes` — Structured markdown notes with `brain_schema: marketing-brain.v1`

### Self-Learning System

Tracks per-step effectiveness across runs:
- Which steps produce the most value per content type
- Content pattern recommendations
- Priority reordering based on historical ROI
- Learning export/import for sharing across machines

### MCP Servers

SeoFlow integrates with MCP servers for live SEO data:
- **SeoCrawl** — GSC, GA4, site audit, AI tracker, tasks (OAuth)
- **Ubersuggest** — Keyword research, SERP data (OAuth)

---

## 18 SEO Agents

| Agent | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **seo-backlinks** | Backlink profile analysis (referring domains, anchor text) |
| **seo-cluster** | SERP-based semantic topic clustering for content architecture |
| **seo-content** | Content quality and E-E-A-T analysis |
| **seo-dataforseo** | Live SEO data via DataForSEO MCP |
| **seo-drift** | SEO drift monitoring (capture baselines) |
| **seo-ecommerce** | E-commerce SEO (Google Shopping, Amazon) |
| **seo-flow** | FLOW framework integration |
| **seo-geo** | Optimize for AI Overviews (SGE, ChatGPT, Gemini) |
| **seo-google** | Google SEO APIs (Search Console, Analytics) |
| **seo-image-gen** | AI image generation for SEO assets |
| **seo-local** | Local SEO (Google Business Profile) |
| **seo-maps** | Maps intelligence (geo-grid rank tracking) |
| **seo-performance** | Core Web Vitals and performance |
| **seo-schema** | Schema.org structured data |
| **seo-sitemap** | XML sitemap analysis and generation |
| **seo-sxo** | Search Experience Optimization |
| **seo-technical** | Technical SEO across 9 categories |
| **seo-visual** | Visual content SEO |

---

## Adding a New Site

1. `bash <(curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imsankz/seoflow/main/install.sh)`
2. Edit `seoflow.config.json` with site details
3. Add API keys to `.env.local`
4. `npm run seoflow:dry` — preview before running
5. `npm run seoflow audit` — run full pipeline

---

## Development

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/imsankz/seoflow.git
cd seoflow
npm install

# Build
npm run build

# Test
npm run seoflow:test          # All tests
npm run seoflow:test:unit     # Unit tests only

# Run locally
npm run seoflow:init
npm run seoflow:status
```

---

## Global Flags Reference

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | Preview changes without writing |
| `--limit` | number | 10 | Max posts to process |
| `--slug` | string | — | Target one specific post |
| `--reset-slug` | bool | false | Re-audit a completed post |
| `--mode` | string | — | Run only one step |
| `--country` | string | — | Country filter |
| `--priority` | number | — | Priority filter (1-3) |
| `--type` | string | — | Content type filter |
| `--go` | bool | false | Actually execute (publish) |
